about.title: Your project begins long before construction.
about.lead: At Dalet Electric, we turn your project’s energy requirements into technically viable, strategically planned infrastructure solutions.
about.p1: We are a Mexican electrical infrastructure developer. We develop solutions that bring industrial, commercial and real estate projects to life in Mexico.
about.p2: We integrate engineering, strategic planning, regulatory coordination and project management to deliver technically viable and economically efficient solutions.
about.p3: Our approach brings together technical expertise, business vision and project structuring to support Mexico’s industrial growth.

privacy.title: Privacy notice
privacy.intro: Information about the processing of data you share through this website.
privacy.draft: Provisional notice: before enabling submissions, DALET ELECTRIC must complete and approve the legal identity and address of the data controller and a channel for exercising data access, rectification, cancellation and objection rights. Submissions remain disabled until the email integration is configured.

sections.title: Data and purpose
sections.text: The forms request your name, company, email, phone and project details. Their purpose is to respond to enquiries, assess electrical infrastructure needs and coordinate meetings. Sensitive personal data is not requested.

sections.title: Delivery and providers
sections.text: When the integration is enabled, requests will be sent to the configured corporate email through Resend as the delivery provider. The website does not maintain a submissions database. The hosting provider may process technical logs for security and operation.

sections.title: Consent and your rights
sections.text: Submitting a request requires acceptance of this notice. To request access to, correction, deletion or objection to processing your data, use the corporate channel that will be published here once confirmed.

sections.title: Security and retention
sections.text: Submissions use data validation, automated submission protections and HTTPS connections in production. The company must define its retention periods and respond to deletion requests in accordance with applicable requirements.

sections.title: Cookies and changes
sections.text: This website does not include advertising or analytics tools. The language selector may store a technical preference. Updates to this notice will be published on this page.
